Flow.description: Calculates and writes Deal Metrics fields on a Quote: TCV, Projected Year 1 MRR, Net New MRR, Blended ACV, Deal Start/End Dates, Effective Deal Term, and Customer Lifecycle Type. Invoke after RLM pricing calculation completes. Input: quoteId (String).

formulas.name: frmDealType
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Ramped_QLG.Id})), IF(ISBLANK(TEXT({!Get_QuoteAction.Type})), "Ramped Deal - New Business", IF(TEXT({!Get_QuoteAction.Type}) = "Amend", "Ramped Deal - Amendment", "Ramped Deal")), IF(ISBLANK(TEXT({!Get_QuoteAction.Type})), "New Business", IF(TEXT({!Get_QuoteAction.Type}) = "Renew", "Renewal", IF(TEXT({!Get_QuoteAction.Type}) = "Amend", "Amendment", IF(TEXT({!Get_QuoteAction.Type}) = "Cancel", "Cancellation", IF(TEXT({!Get_QuoteAction.Type}) = "Rollback", "Rollback", IF(TEXT({!Get_QuoteAction.Type}) = "Transfer", "Transfer", IF(TEXT({!Get_QuoteAction.Type}) = "Swap", "Swap", "New Business"))))))))

Flow.label: RLM Quote Deal Metrics
